question:
An AI doesn’t invent from nothing. It remixes patterns it has seen before. Be the remix machine, then be the human who makes the story surprising.

Steps:
1. Start recording. Pick one character and one setting from the chart below.
2. Be the machine: tell a 15-second story that mixes the two, using only the most predictable ideas.
3. Be the human co-creator: tell the story again in 15 seconds with one surprising twist from your own life or imagination.
4. Say which part came from patterns and which part came from you.

Characters:
- A detective
- A robot barista
- A medieval knight
- A deep-sea diver

Settings:
- A school cafeteria
- A space station
- A talent show
- A tiny village

rubric.description: Student does not tell a story on camera.
Student tells only one version of the story.
Student tells a predictable version using both chosen ideas AND a second version with one surprising twist AND says which part came from patterns and which came from them.
Meets all of the above AND explains why the twist needed something an AI would not have (such as a personal experience, a feeling, or knowledge of a community).
